note: Rules consumed by scripts/slop-scan.mjs. `pattern` is a JS regex source string. `ext` limits the rule to file extensions ('*' = any scanned file). A finding is a lead, not a verdict - confirm in the code before acting.

rules.message: Purple-to-blue gradient - the single most recognisable AI-design signature
rules.fix: One flat brand colour. If depth is needed, vary lightness within one hue, or use a large soft radial in a tinted neutral.

rules.message: Default violet/indigo gradient stop - decorative gradient with no semantic meaning
rules.fix: Remove, or replace with a single-hue lightness gradient interpolated `in oklch`.

rules.message: Pure #000 / #fff - no real surface is pure; reads as unconsidered
rules.fix: Tint the extremes: oklch(0.16 0.012 <hue>) dark, oklch(0.985 0.004 <hue>) light.

rules.message: Default mid-grey (#888/#999/#aaa/#ccc) - usually also fails contrast
rules.fix: Use the step of a tinted neutral ramp that measures >= 4.5:1. Check with scripts/contrast.mjs.

rules.message: Untouched Tailwind gray-400/500 - the default palette is an AI-slop tell and often fails contrast
rules.fix: Define a tinted neutral ramp in @theme (v4) or the config (v3), or at minimum switch to slate/stone/zinc deliberately.

rules.message: Accent-coloured glow - emphasis everywhere means emphasis nowhere
rules.fix: Glow on the single primary action, or nowhere.

rules.message: Gradient text - reduces contrast, breaks in dark mode, dates instantly
rules.fix: Solid colour. Use size and weight for emphasis instead.

rules.message: transition: all animates properties you did not intend, including layout ones
rules.fix: Name them: transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), opacity 180ms var(--ease-out)

rules.message: Animating from scale(0) - nothing in the real world appears from nothing
rules.fix: Start at scale(0.95)-scale(0.98) combined with opacity: 0.

rules.message: ease-in starts slow at the exact moment the user is watching. Never use it on an enter
rules.fix: var(--ease-out) = cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1). ease-in is only defensible on an exit.

rules.message: Overshoot/bounce easing on UI - adds perceived latency and reads as toy-like
rules.fix: Reserve bounce for drag-release and rare playful moments. Standard UI uses ease-out.

rules.message: Animating a layout property - triggers layout on every frame
rules.fix: Animate transform/opacity. For size, use grid-template-rows: 0fr to 1fr, interpolate-size, or FLIP.

rules.message: UI transition of 500ms or more - everything feels heavy
rules.fix: Tooltip 125-200ms, dropdown 150-250ms, modal 200-300ms. Drawers and marketing motion may exceed this.

rules.message: Stylesheet defines animation but never handles prefers-reduced-motion
rules.fix: Add a reduce block that substitutes opacity for movement. See templates/motion.css.

rules.message: Transform-on-hover with no (hover: hover) guard - touch devices fire hover on tap
rules.fix: @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { ... }

rules.message: Focus outline removed - keyboard users cannot see where they are (WCAG 2.4.7)
rules.fix: Delete it, or replace with :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

rules.message: Zoom disabled - fails WCAG 1.4.4 Resize Text
rules.fix: content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"

rules.message: Positive tabindex - breaks the natural tab order
rules.fix: Use 0 to make focusable, -1 for programmatic focus only. Fix the DOM order instead.

rules.message: Clickable div/span with no role - not keyboard operable, not announced as a control
rules.fix: Use <button type="button">. If it navigates, use <a href>.

rules.message: alert() as user feedback - not a designed state
rules.fix: Inline message for anything actionable, toast for transient confirmation.

rules.message: Magic z-index - a bigger number does not escape an ancestor stacking context
rules.fix: Tokenise the layers, and use a portal or the popover API for overlays.

rules.message: !important - usually a specificity problem, not a solution
rules.fix: Fix the cascade. Legitimate exceptions: reduced-motion overrides, third-party resets.

rules.message: Arbitrary pixel value - an orphan outside the spacing/type scale
rules.fix: Snap to the nearest scale step, or add the value to the scale.

rules.message: 100vh is taller than the visible area on mobile - content hides under browser chrome
rules.fix: Use 100svh for anything that must fit; 100dvh only when reflow-while-scrolling is acceptable.

rules.message: Emoji in markup - font-dependent, inconsistent per platform, untintable
rules.fix: Use a vector icon set (Lucide, Phosphor, Radix Icons, SF Symbols).

rules.pattern: lorem ipsum|dolor sit amet|John Doe|Jane Doe|\[Feature Name\]|Placeholder text
rules.message: Placeholder content in delivered UI - signals unfinished work and hides real layout problems
rules.fix: Write real copy. Real content changes the design.

rules.message: Unfinished marker in delivered code
rules.fix: Finish it, or state clearly that it is out of scope.

rules.pattern: (?:unlock the power|take your [a-z ]{2,20} to the next level|in today's fast-paced|seamlessly integrat|revolutioniz|supercharge your|game-?changing|cutting-?edge|state-of-the-art|elevate your|say goodbye to|effortlessly|next-generation|best-in-class|world-class|the future of [a-z]+ is here|whether you're a)
rules.message: Marketing slop phrase - would be true of any product, so it says nothing
rules.fix: State what it does, for whom, and what changes. See reference/copywriting.md section 2.

rules.pattern: >\s*(?:Get Started|Learn More|Click here|Discover more|Explore now|Read more)\s*<
rules.message: Generic CTA - carries no information about what happens next
rules.fix: Verb + object, unique on the page: "Start a free project", "See the 2-minute demo".

rules.pattern: No data(?: available)?[."'`<]|Nothing to (?:show|display)[."'`<]|Something went wrong
rules.message: Empty or error state that tells the user nothing
rules.fix: Empty: name what belongs here and offer the action. Error: what happened, why, what to do next.

rules.message: Stylesheet defines hover states but no focus-visible state
rules.fix: Every hover affordance needs a focus equivalent - keyboard users get nothing otherwise.

rules.message: without dimensions or aspect-ratio - a guaranteed layout shift
rules.fix: Add width/height attributes or aspect-ratio. Use the framework image component where available.

rules.message: will-change wastes GPU memory when left on permanently, and can reduce performance
rules.fix: Add before the animation, remove after. Never a static declaration on many elements.

rules.message: Motion x/y/scale shorthand is not hardware-accelerated - it runs on the main thread
rules.fix: animate={{ transform: "translateX(100px)" }} for the GPU path, or use CSS.

rules.message: Possible card-inside-card-inside-card - three container levels in one class chain
rules.fix: Flatten to one container level. Separate with space or a background shift, not a third border.
